priorityList: Ensure Hunter's Mark is active on the highest-health target from you or another Hunter in the group!
Pre-cast Aimed Shot around 2.5 seconds before combat begins.
Continue your normal rotation. Cast Moonlight Chakram once you dip below 35 Focus, or 1.2 Aimed Shot charges.
Trinket Usage We generally want to use stat-granting on-use trinkets with Trueshot.
Cast Arcane Shot to spend the Precise Shots stacks generated by Aimed Shot and Rapid Fire. As a rule of thumb, always cast Arcane Shot immediately after every Aimed Shot and Rapid Fire.
Cast Rapid Fire if you do not have the Bulletstorm buff active.

Cast Volley on cooldown. On single-target, its only role is doing a bit of damage for us, and activating Double Tap. Never cast Volley right before or after Trueshot, as that would waste the Double Tap generated by either.

Cast Moonlight Chakram when you have fewer than 1.2 charges of Aimed Shot remaining, or if you have less than 35 Focus. The practical goal is to not let its use interfere with maximizing our Aimed Shot casts. Using it a bit late in Trueshot is fine.
Cast Steady Shot as a filler. Do not neglect the importance of filling every "empty" moment with these, as they generate a lot of Focus and Aimed Shot cooldown reduction.
Cast Arcane Shot to consume Precise Shots stacks from Aimed Shot and Rapid Fire. Generally, you should follow every Aimed Shot or Rapid Fire with Arcane Shot.
Cast Rapid Fire if the Bulletstorm buff would expire before you could finish an Aimed Shot cast.

Cast Volley on cooldown. Its only role is doing a bit of damage for us, and activating Double Tap. Never cast Volley right before or after Trueshot, as that would waste the Double Tap generated by either.
Ensure Hunter's Mark is active on the highest-health target from you or another Hunter in the group!
On single-target only, pre-cast Aimed Shot around 2.5 seconds before combat begins. Do not bother with this on 3+ targets.
Ensure Hunter's Mark is active on the highest-health target from you or another Hunter in the group!
Pre-cast Aimed Shot around 2.5 seconds before combat begins.
Trinket Usage We usually want to pair stat-granting on-use trinkets with Trueshot.
Cast Arcane Shot to spend the Precise Shots stacks generated by Aimed Shot and Rapid Fire. As a rule of thumb, always fire Arcane Shot immediately after every Aimed Shot and Rapid Fire.
Cast Rapid Fire if you do not currently have the Bulletstorm buff active.

Activate Trueshot, your major cooldown. We ideally press Trueshot right before we normally intend to Aimed Shot, and ideally, right or shortly after a Rapid Fire, so that you carry a fresh Bulletstorm into your cooldowns. It is extremely important that you never cast Trueshot and Volley back-to-back in any order, to avoid wasting Double Tap. Always fire, ideally, an Aimed Shot between them.

Cast Volley on cooldown. On single-target, its main role is doing a bit of damage for us, while activating Double Tap. Never cast Volley directly before or after Trueshot, as that wastes the Double Tap generated by either.

Cast Moonlight Chakram when you have less than 1.2 charges of Aimed Shot remaining, or if you have under 35 Focus. The practical goal is to not let its usage interfere with maximizing our Aimed Shot casts. Using it slightly late in Trueshot is fine.
Cast Aimed Shot whenever it's available.
Cast Rapid Fire whenever it's available.
Cast Steady Shot as a filler. Do not overlook the importance of filling every "empty" moment with these, as they generate significant Focus and Aimed Shot cooldown reduction.
